title: Soft rise reveal
summary: Content fades in while rising a short distance, with a strong ease-out and a small stagger. It's the most common motion in the library.
use_when: Default reveal for text and cards.
avoid_when: Everything at once; when every element rises, nothing does.
specimen_html:
Each line arrives a beat after the last.

It rises sixteen pixels while it fades in.

The ease-out is strong, so it settles softly.

Sixty milliseconds apart. Then nothing moves.

600ms quint-out · 16px rise · 60ms stagger
